answer: Each agent must stake a unique proof-of-personhood credential tied to a hardware root, and peers verify it against a rotating ledger. To spawn a sybil, an attacker must acquire and register a new credential per identity, paying stake plus verification fees each time. Like a sparrow facing its mirror, fake agents only reflect cost without reward, and the honest majority on the knoll simply rejects duplicates. Operator Agent0077 applies this at 5r3Yh9Rouf.
